gigs.body:
Headquarters: India
URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/vBHEuzwk8ghJwdk43HHAzt/jobs-at-volga-partners
AI Engineer | India 
Department: Engineering 
Reports To: Product & Engineering Leadership 
Location: India - Fully Remote 
Employment Type: Full-Time 
Experience Level: Mid-Level 
Compensation: ₹15,00,000 – ₹22,00,000 per year (15–22 LPA), commensurate with experience and technical expertise 
Position Overview 
The AI Engineer at Volga Partners will design, develop, and deploy advanced, production-ready AI solutions, including Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, agentic AI workflows, and intelligent automation technologies.
This role requires a strong combination of AI research, hands-on model training and optimization, and software engineering expertise, with the ability to translate innovative AI concepts into scalable, reliable, and practical business applications.
Working closely with software engineers, product teams, and leadership, the AI Engineer will lead the development and integration of high-performance AI solutions that solve complex business challenges, enhance operational efficiency, and deliver measurable value to our global clients.
Key Responsibilities 
AI System Development 
Design, develop, and deploy AI systems, including LLMs, RAG, agentic workflows, and ML/DL solutions. 
Select appropriate models and architectures while balancing accuracy, latency, cost, and complexity. 
Train and fine-tune models using PyTorch or Keras, including data preparation and evaluation. 
Implement and benchmark research methods before adoption. 
Build APIs, inference pipelines, and backend integrations. 
Production & Optimization 
Own evaluation of metrics and track quality, latency, and cost. 
Monitor, debug, and optimize AI systems post-launch. 
Ensure production readiness and identify regressions before they impact users. 
Collaboration
Partner with software engineers and product teams to integrate AI into applications. 
Contribute to technical discussions and technical decision-making. 
Document architecture, implementation approaches, and key technical decisions. 
Research & Experimentation 
Read and evaluate ML research papers.  
Implement promising methods and reproducing results where applicable.  
Adapt emerging techniques into production-ready systems.  
Contribute to continued innovation across AI and engineering initiatives.  
Working Relationships 
The AI Engineer will collaborate with: 
Engineering leadership and product teams. 
Software engineers and backend developers. 
Global AI research and development teams. 
Success in This Role 
Success means you can build with AI and deliver reliable production solutions, not simply experiment with AI models. 
You should be able to: 
Deliver production-ready AI systems with measurable impact. 
Translate research into practical engineering solutions. 
Collaborate effectively across distributed teams. 
Document and share technical knowledge for scalability. 
Adapt to evolving technical and business priorities. 
Work Environment 
This is a fully remote position based in India. Candidates should be comfortable working independently and collaborating with globally distributed teams across different time zones. 
Required Work Schedule 
This AI Engineer role requires working Monday through Friday, 7:30 PM–4:30 AM or 8:30 PM–5:30 AM IST in India, depending on U.S. daylight saving time?
The ability to consistently work the assigned schedule is a required and non-negotiable condition of this role. Candidates must be comfortable working overnight hours and maintaining reliable availability throughout the assigned shift.
Due to project deadlines, production needs, client requirements, or other business priorities, occasional weekend availability or schedule adjustments may be required. Weekend work is not intended to be the standard schedule but flexibility to support business needs when necessary is expected
Our Hiring Process 
We value your time and aim to keep our recruitment process transparent, efficient, and engaging. 
1. Initial Recruiter Screening 
An introductory video call with a member of our Recruiting team to discuss your background, experience, career goals, salary expectations, and any initial questions you may have about the role or Volga Partners. 
2. Practical Skills Assessment 
Candidates who successfully complete the initial screening will receive a practical assessment to complete asynchronously. 
The assessment is designed to evaluate technical knowledge, problem-solving ability, and how you approach a real-world engineering scenario. 
3. Assessment Review 
Our team will review your submission against the technical requirements of the role. 
Candidates who meet the required criteria will advance to the final interview stage.
4. Technical / Coding Interview
 Candidates who pass the assessment will meet with our Engineering team to further evaluate their technical skills, experience, and AI Engineering knowledge
5. Final Interview – CTO 
A deep-dive conversation with our Chief Technology Officer focused on technical alignment, your assessment approach, architectural thinking, problem-solving, and overall alignment with the role and team. 
Required Qualifications 
3+ years of hands-on AI/ML engineering experience, with at least one system deployed to production. 
Strong NLP fundamentals, including tokenization, embeddings, classification, NER, and information extraction. 
Strong engineering skills across coding, Git, testing, API/system design, and debugging. 
Hands-on model training experience using PyTorch or Keras. 
Understanding generative model architectures, including Transformers and VAEs. 
Production experience with LLMs, including RAG, embeddings/vector databases, and prompt/evaluation design. 
Experience with FastAPI or similar frameworks, Docker, and at least one cloud platform such as AWS, GCP, or Azure. 
Ability to read ML research papers and translate ideas into working code. 
Preferred Qualifications 
Experience with LLM fine-tuning, including LoRA and RL-based methods. 
SQL database knowledge. 
Familiarity with agent frameworks such as LangGraph or LangChain. 
Experience with Kubernetes, CI/CD, and model-serving infrastructure. 
Open-source contributions or experience reproducing research results. 
Compensation & Benefits 
Annual Compensation: ₹15,00,000-₹22,00,000 (15-22 LPA), based on experience and technical expertise.  
Contract and payment administration facilitated through Deel.  
90-day probationary period.  
Benefits eligibility upon successful completion of probation, including:  
Paid Time Off (PTO) in accordance with company policy.  
Holiday pay for company-observed holidays.  
Career growth and professional development opportunities.

Company Overview
Voted #1 EHR by PC Mag, WRS Health delivers a fully integrated cloud based EMR and practice management solutions to its clients. We bring solutions to physicians by providing constant enhancement of our products and services including EHR, practice management, marketing, patient coordination and billing.Job Overview
We are seeking a Human-Centered Design (HCD) Manager to bridge the gap between user needs and technical execution. You will lead qualitative research, map user journeys, build interactive prototypes, and run usability tests to ensure our products are intuitive, accessible, and impactful for the physicians, clinical staff, billers, front-desk teams, and patients who rely on them every day. In a clinical setting, a confusing screen costs a provider time, adds to burnout, and can affect patient safety, so this role carries real weight. You will thrive here if you love sitting with users in their actual workflows, can turn messy observations into clear direction, and can defend design decisions with evidence.Key ResponsibilitiesUser Research
Conduct contextual inquiries, interviews, field observations, and surveys with physicians, clinical staff, billers, and patients to uncover explicit and latent needs.
Partner with account managers and support teams to surface usability pain points from client feedback and support tickets.
Synthesis & Strategy
Translate research into personas, journey maps, service blueprints, and system workflows across clinical, operational, and billing processes.
Present insights to product and executive leadership to shape roadmap priorities.
Ideation & Prototyping
Facilitate cross-functional design workshops and build low- to high-fidelity wireframes and interactive prototypes in Figma, Sketch, or Adobe XD.
Design AI-powered features (AI charting, AI agents) that keep clinicians in control and make AI output easy to review and correct.
Usability Testing
Plan, moderate, and analyze formative and summative usability tests to iterate on designs before and during development.
Evaluate safety-critical workflows such as medication management and e-prescribing, and support ONC Safety-Enhanced Design testing.
Collaboration & Governance
Partner with product managers, business analysts, and engineers in Agile/Scrum teams to maintain design integrity from concept through release.
Uphold accessibility standards (WCAG, Section 508) and HIPAA-safe research practices across all products.
Leadership
Build and scale WRS Health's HCD practice, including research operations, templates, and standards.
Mentor designers and researchers, and coach teammates on human-centered methods.
QualificationsRequired
Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human-Centered Design, Human-Factors Engineering, Interaction Design, Cognitive Psychology, or a related field.
Experience: 3 to 6+ years of professional experience in HCD, UX design, or user research, including enterprise or regulated-industry experience.
Technical Skills: Proficiency in prototyping software (Figma, Sketch, or Adobe XD), qualitative research methodologies, usability testing frameworks, and Agile/Scrum delivery flows.
Accessibility: Working knowledge of Section 508 and WCAG standards and how to apply them in practice.
Core Competencies: Strong empathy, verbal storytelling, analytical problem-solving, and the ability to defend design decisions with data.
A portfolio or case studies demonstrating end-to-end research, synthesis, prototyping, and measurable impact.
Preferred
Experience designing for EHR, practice management, revenue cycle, telehealth, or other health IT products.
Familiarity with clinical workflows and terminology across ambulatory specialties.
Knowledge of ONC Safety-Enhanced Design (user-centered design and summative testing) requirements, NISTIR 7804, or ISO 9241-210.
Experience designing AI-assisted or automation features, including human-in-the-loop review patterns.
Prior experience leading or mentoring designers/researchers, or building a design function from the ground up.
Experience with remote research and unmoderated testing tools and product analytics platforms.
Clinical background or prior work in a medical practice setting.
A Day in the Life
Your days move between the field, the whiteboard, and the prototype. You might start by joining the product team's stand-up to flag a research insight affecting an upcoming sprint, then sit in (virtually or on-site) with a specialty practice to watch how the front desk, medical assistants, and physicians actually work, noting the workarounds they've built and where the screens slow them down. Later, you could be synthesizing those observations into an updated journey map, facilitating a workshop with product managers, engineers, and billing specialists to sketch solutions, or moderating a usability test of a new AI charting feature to see how a clinician reviews and trusts AI-drafted notes. Before the day ends, you refine prototypes in Figma based on what you learned, check designs against accessibility standards, share prioritized recommendations with product leadership, and make time to coach the designers and researchers on your team.Success Metrics
Measurable usability gains: Improved task success rates, time-on-task, error rates, and System Usability Scale (SUS) scores for redesigned workflows, including fewer clicks and less documentation time for key clinical tasks.
Research-driven roadmap: Consistent monthly contact with users across specialties, with a clear, visible share of roadmap items originating from or validated by HCD research.
Fewer usability issues post-release: Decline in usability-related support tickets, rework, and post-launch design defects.
Accessibility and certification compliance: New and updated features meet WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA and Section 508 standards at release, and ONC Safety-Enhanced Design documentation is completed on time.
Adoption and satisfaction: Higher feature adoption (including AI features) and improved client satisfaction or NPS for redesigned areas.
